About Us

Cimatron provides toolmakers with an integrated CAD/CAM solution for the design and manufacture of plastic injection molds, electrodes, and sheet metal stamping dies, as well as programming 2D to 5-Axis CNC machines. Created with the toolmaker in mind, Cimatron provides intelligent automation that complements the toolmaker’s skills to deliver the highest quality tools while compressing production time and cost.

Part of the Sandvik Group

Cimatron Systems is part of the Sandvik Group – A high-tech and global engineering company offering products and services that enhance customer productivity, profitability and sustainability. In 2025, the group had approximately 42,000 employees, sales in more than 150 countries and revenues of about SEK 121 billion.
